title: FFH-Richtlinie Anhang I – Lebensraumtypen (selection relevant around Central European cities)
publisher: Bundesamt für Naturschutz (BfN): Liste der in Deutschland vorkommenden Lebensraumtypen der FFH-Richtlinie (Annex I of Directive 92/43/EEC)
version: Annex I names as of 13.05.2013 (Directive 2013/17/EU); BfN list PDF of 25.09.2018
license_note: Codes and names are facts of EU law. The directive prescribes no map colours.
note: Codes without the asterisk; priority = true marks priority types (*). Through the prefix fallback a starred spelling (91E0*) resolves to its base code; 6210* (orchid-rich stands) has its own entry. protected = listed in Annex I; the legal protection of a concrete stand depends on Natura 2000 site rules and national biotope protection. name_short = BfN short name; baykompv = Bavarian BNT ↔ biotope-mapping sub-types linked in the Biotopwertliste. Covers the types transcribed in the research (40 of the 93 types occurring in Germany).
